To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
lambda P protein inhibiting DnaA protein is a novel mechanism by which lambda phage can inhibit host DNA replication and thus promote its own DNA replication.

the lambda P DNA replication protein inhibits the DNA replication initiator DnaA protein of E. coli and this inhibition causes the inhibition of bacterial DNA synthesis initiation, which leads to bacterial death.
the lambda P inhibits the binding to the wild-type but not to the mutant DnaA protein.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of the interaction of lambda P with E. coli DnaA, and the effect of the interaction on the DNA synthesis initiation in E. coli.
the molecular mechanisms by which lambda P protein inhibitory effect on E. coli DNA replication and its possible beneficial effect for lambda DNA replication are achieved.
the interaction between the lambda DNA replication protein (P) and the E. coli DNA replication initiator protein (DnaA) and the effects of this interaction on bacterial growth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lambda P inhibits the binding functions of the E. coli DNA replication initiator protein, DnaA, which causes the arrest of bacterial DNA synthesis initiation and leads to bacterial death.
the lambda P inhibits the DNA replication of the host bacterium by inhibiting the DNA replication initiation protein DnaA.
lambda P protein inhibiting the oriC DNA binding of DnaA protein is the primary cause of bacterial death, and the inhibition of ATP binding of Dna A protein is a secondary effect of lambda P protein.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the lambda P and E. coli DnaA proteins have antagonistic roles in the regulation of bacterial and phage DNA synthesis.
lambda P protein inhibitory effect on DnaA function is a new mechanism of lambda DNA replication.
the lambda P-DnaA interaction inhibits the initiation of host chromosomal replication and thus provides a selective advantage for phage lambda DNA synthesis.

the lambda P inhibitory effect on the oriC DNA binding of DnaA is specific to the wild-type protein and not to the mutant rpl Dna protein.
